atoms.b: Sam and Jayden are twins. They are in year five. Sam wears glasses and likes to swim and play saxophone. Jayden is in the school choir and likes to play cricket. Sam’s favourite colour is green and his favourite class is English. Jayden likes to canoe in the summer and wears funny socks.
